create_captions_dataset: create a CaptionsDatabase instance to load Flickr image-caption pairs from a JSON annotations file
create_coco_dataset: create a COCOAnnotationDatabase instance to load COCO image-caption pairs with capped sentences and path fixes
create_conceptual_captions_dataset: create a ConceptualCaptionsDatabase instance to load image-caption pairs from a gzipped TSV file
review_dataset_splits: review the SPLITS class attribute on CaptionsDatabase, COCOAnnotationDatabase, or ConceptualCaptionsDatabase to understand train-val-test partitioning
refactor_load_annotation_db: refactor the _load_annotation_db method on a captions database class to support a new annotation file format
